description: This file is the main entry point for a React application. It initializes the React DOM root, specifies rendering of the App component within React.StrictMode, and includes imports for React, ReactDOM, CSS styling, and the App component.

methods.name: ReactDOM.createRoot
methods.description: Creates a root for rendering React components into a DOM node.

methods.name: root.render
methods.description: Renders the React component tree into the created root.
